sourceLibrary.title.source: Sources — research papers, public references and creator listings
sourceLibrary.title.text: 来源 — 研究论文、公开参考及创作者信息

sourceLibrary.description.source: Explore research papers by title, author, year and DOI alongside publishers, cited documents, retained feeds and creator listings. Bibliography, reading and payments remain separate.
sourceLibrary.description.text: 按标题、作者、年份及 DOI 探索论文，以及出版者、被引用文档、保留订阅源和创作者信息。文献、阅读及付款保持独立。

sourceLibrary.intro.source: Explore original research-paper records, publisher documentation and writing, documents cited in public answers, retained feeds and creator listings. Sources remain visible without publisher verification. Reading scope, publisher control and creator payments are separate records.
sourceLibrary.intro.text: 探索原始研究论文记录、出版者文档及文章、公开答案引用文档、保留订阅源和创作者信息。无出版者核验来源仍可见。阅读范围、出版者控制及创作者付款独立记录。

sourceLibrary.publisherLinks.text: 原始链接 · 提问时阅读

sourceLibrary.directoryUnavailable.source: Part of the directory could not be loaded. Available records are shown below; a missing count is not an empty catalog.
sourceLibrary.directoryUnavailable.text: 部分目录无法加载。可用记录显示在下方；缺少计数不代表空目录。

sourceLibrary.reviewNotice.source: Save papers, record screening notes and prepare a comparison. Your list stays on this browser.
sourceLibrary.reviewNotice.text: 保存论文、记录筛选笔记并准备比较。列表保留在此浏览器。

sourceLibrary.freeDiscovery.text: 原始记录 · 免费发现

sourceLibrary.bibliographyNotice.source: A starter bibliography from arXiv, OpenReview, PMLR and ACL Anthology. Metadata identifies papers and observed versions; it does not establish full-text access, peer review or scientific accuracy. Matching DOI or arXiv work identifiers group records while preserving their original versions.
sourceLibrary.bibliographyNotice.text: 来自 arXiv、OpenReview、PMLR 及 ACL Anthology 的初始参考文献。元数据标识论文及观察版本，不确立全文访问、同行评审或科学准确性。匹配 DOI 或 arXiv 作品标识分组记录，并保留原版本。

sourceLibrary.papersEmpty.source: No starter paper matches these filters. You can search the repositories below.
sourceLibrary.papersEmpty.text: 无初始论文匹配过滤器。可搜索下方资料库。

sourceLibrary.publisherNotice.source: Starting points for AI and agents, data and infrastructure, payments, and creator research. These are links to original publishers, not retained article evidence. Open the publisher or draft a question with its URL; available content still needs to be read and assessed.
sourceLibrary.publisherNotice.text: AI 及代理、数据及基础设施、付款和创作者研究的起点。这些是原出版者链接，不是保留文章证据。打开出版者或以其 URL 草拟问题；仍需阅读及评估可用内容。

sourceLibrary.freeReading.text: 免费阅读 · 原出版者链接

sourceLibrary.feedNotice.source: These are retained feed snapshots. Keryx also discovers supported websites and PDFs when you ask a question; this directory is not a complete index of the web. A feed excerpt, abstract or video description may omit the full work. Listing here does not certify content accuracy.
sourceLibrary.feedNotice.text: 这些是保留订阅源快照。提问时 Keryx 还发现受支持网站及 PDF；目录不是完整网络索引。订阅源摘录、摘要或视频说明可能缺少完整作品。收录不认证内容准确性。

sourceLibrary.referencesUnavailable.source: Public references are temporarily unavailable. Try this page again to inspect the retained catalog.
sourceLibrary.referencesUnavailable.text: 公开参考暂不可用。请重试此页查看保留目录。

sourceLibrary.creatorNotice.source: Listings remain visible while publisher control is unverified. On-chain registration records a listing and its payout terms; it does not prove publisher control or content accuracy. Reading and earning eligibility depend on the applicable verification, policy and evidence checks.
sourceLibrary.creatorNotice.text: 出版者控制未核验时来源仍可见。链上注册记录信息及收款条款，不证明出版者控制或内容准确性。阅读及收益资格取决于适用核验、政策和证据检查。
